description: Structures en charge de l'assainissement non collectif des eaux usées par commune du SAGE NRG is a dataset listed in Gers-OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SAGE NRG. Structures en charge de la gestion de l'assainissement non-collectif des eaux usées domestiques par commune du SAGE Neste et Rivières de Gascogne en 2018 La Commission Locale de l’Eau Neste & Rivières de Gascogne, en charge de l’élaboration du Schéma d’Aménagement et de Gestion des Eaux, met à disposition à l’ensemble du public l’ensemble des ... Coverage: Gers. The portal files it under Développement durable. Its keywords are Assainissement, SAGE. The portal shows 660 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-01-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gers-fr-portal.
